decisions.reason: The conferencing service remains a low-cost option while demand uncertainty persists.
The Hong Kong adoption validates its value, so the option remains open with low dropout risk.
The dedicated page and alignment with optical strengths keep the option worth maintaining.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy, low-growth service with no positive results, so the option is abandoned to free resources.
Direct voice connection retains business relevance despite uncertainty, so the option is kept.
